sn47.11:1.2: atha kho āyasmā sāriputto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. -pe- ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā sāriputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn47.11:1.4: kittāvatā nu kho: bhante, mahāpuriso hotī”ti:
sn47.11:2.2: idha sāriputta, bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati. ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.11:2.3: tassa kāye kāyānupassino viharato cittaṃ virajjati, vimuccati anupādāya āsavehi.
sn47.11:2.6: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati, ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.11:2.7: tassa dhammesu dhammānupassino viharato cittaṃ virajjati, vimuccati, anupādāya āsavehi.
